toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
The rejects come from one combination: Arnholt resin run through Dryer D5 while D5 is degraded. Arnholt lots on Press 5 reject at about 9.9%, while Quillan on the same press is at 0.9%, and Arnholt on Press 7 (dried in the good dryer D7) is at 0.8%. Operators make no difference: new hires and experienced staff both reject at about 10% on Arnholt. In a week 42 test, one Arnholt lot gave 10.4% rejects through D5 and 0.8% when dried in a portable dryer. Arnholt is not defective by itself, the new operators are not the cause, and D5 is not a problem for Quillan resin.

I am fairly confident in this. Caveat: all Arnholt samples came from the unconditioned north annex, so whether annex storage adds moisture is not yet tested.

Next: repair D5's heater and desiccant, confirm a dew point near -40 °C, and restore the original alarm limit. Until then, keep Arnholt off D5. Do not put the six operators on improvement plans.
output.methodChoice: EDF-1 with evidence limited to E1-E5 plus X9 and X5
